title: Syrian-Style Kebabs
description: Tender lamb kebabs marinated in a mix of Middle Eastern spices, perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, salt, black pepper, parsley, and kebab spice mix.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until they are well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until they are cooked through.
Brush the kebabs with the kissed lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
